about: Match modes (creator: Solo, Duos, Trios and Squads, each with its own portal in the hub; the match starts in the mode everyone is standing on). teamSize = fighters per team; bots play in teams of the same size and fill a short party. portal = its hub piece, which fills one floor square in the mode's colour: edge = its rim block, the hub row's block = its glass (creator: match the hologram's colour).
